# IELTS Reading

## Core concept
IELTS Reading tests comprehension of passages and locating information under time pressure.

## How it works
Skim for overall purpose, scan for key words, then read the relevant lines carefully.

## What to watch out for
Answers may paraphrase the question; do not rely only on identical words.

## Worked example
If the text says sales fell by 20%, the statement sales increased is FALSE.

## Try it yourself
Write a new example using the rule and explain why it works.
